products.name: Bow keychain
products.description: A charming handcrafted red bow keychain made with soft cotton yarn. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Tulip & Rose Handmade Crochet Bouquet
products.description: The cotton yarn is a soft, breathable, natural-fibre yarn with a smooth texture, ideal for creating detailed crochet flowers, accessories, keychains, and other handmade pieces. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Love & Blooms Deluxe Gift Hamper
products.description: The ultimate gift hamper! Includes 1 Tulip Bouquet, 1 Mini Bunny Keychain, 1 Daisy Hair Scrunchie, and a personalized handwritten gift card inside an aesthetic box. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Vintage Daisy Crochet Hair Scrunchie Set
products.description: Super cute set of 3 hand-stitched floral scrunchies. Soft on hair, no pulling or creasing. Features cute 3D daisy flower accents. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Mini Fluffy Bunny & Heart Keychain Trio
products.description: Pocket-sized crochet joy! Set of 3 adorable mini bunny keychains with shiny pearl beads and silver keyrings attached. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Forever Sunflower Single Stem
products.description: A single bright sunflower crafted with golden petals and textured center. Option to order as stem only or gift wrapped in clear aesthetic craft paper. Gift wrapping optional.

products.name: Crochet Floral Hair Clip Set
products.description: Hand-stitched mini flower clips with sturdy alligator clip backings. Ideal for adding a touch of floral magic to any hairstyle! Gift wrapping optional.

reviews.comment: Prisha's bouquet is so incredibly gorgeous! The gift wrapping with the gift wrapping was so aesthetically pleasing. Made with love indeed ♡
Ordered the Love & Blooms Gift Hamper for my best friend's birthday and she loved every single item! The hair scrunchie and bouquet are perfection.
